dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Pongo arrived at MACC as a stray with no known history. When he arrived, Pongo was observed to be highly social with handlers and would accept contact with a loose body. On the 5th of November Pongo was taken to the yard to interact with another dog. This interaction quickly escalated to Pongo biting, holding, and shaking the other dog. When handlers attempted to break up the incident, Pongo bit one of them on the hand, resulting in multiple puncture wounds. Pongo did not break skin on the other dog. Due to the detailed behavior we recommend an adult only, single pet home, with no trips to the dog park.
dog.name: Pongo
